title: connector apps: the batch-1 manifests (`connector-github`, `connector-stripe`) carry no `iconUrl`, which marketplace review requires, so cloud's ingestion has to pass `--icon-url` as a stopgap
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (a). Reported by cloud seat 2 on #27293 (comment 6554555411, the first cloud ingestion run) and re-read by this seat. Child of #27293 (E4). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` publish door — `os package publish` reads `m.iconUrl` from `objectstack.manifest.json` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts:653`, read at `origin/main` `617dcf43`). The handbook says the README and the icon are required for a complete listing (`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx:39` and `:170`). Cloud's ingestion script published `connector-github` only by passing `--icon-url app=…`.

## The defect

`packages/apps/connector-github/objectstack.manifest.json` and `packages/apps/connector-stripe/objectstack.manifest.json` (read at `617dcf43`) have no `iconUrl`. The one existing official app's manifest carries one: the handbook's own example at `:56` is `app.objectstack.hotcrm`'s `raw.githubusercontent.com/.../assets/icon.svg`.

## Work

Give each batch-1 app an icon that its package owns, and set `iconUrl` to its public http(s) URL, the way hotcrm does. The image must respect the vendor's published brand guidelines; a neutral connector glyph is the safe default when they are unclear. Add a test in each app's `test/` that fails when `iconUrl` is absent or not http(s). That keeps the next shelf app from shipping without one. If the shelf's later apps should share one rule, say so in the report; do not add a repo-wide gate.

## Business reason

The listing is the administrator's first sight of the app. Without its own icon every listing depends on a flag the cloud script has to remember.

## Reader

The triage seat grades and routes it; the epic PM of #27293 dispatches.

## Dedupe

The 500 most recent issues and PRs (read 2026-11-01T07:03Z), titles grepped for `iconUrl|icon_url|\bicon\b`: 0 hits; control `connector` on the same set: 53 hits.
